description: Grant Milestone Verifier with Signed Release Attestation — Decides whether a grantee met a milestone before a DAO releases the next tranche or stream. Checks GitHub as of the due date (commits, tags, releases, CI, files), npm/PyPI/crates.io publish times, Snapshot proposal state, on-chain deployments (bytecode selector scan through proxies, Sourcify, creation transaction), and URLs; judges the rest with an ensemble plus a skeptical reviewer, reads Sablier

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit, or a commit range base...head.

repoUrl.description: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>. A link copied from GitHub also works: .../tree/<branch>, .../releases/tag/<tag> or .../commit/<sha> sets ref when ref is omitted.

dueDate.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp. A date means end of that day UTC. GitHub, registry, Snapshot and contract checks are evaluated as of this instant.

windowStart.description: Optional ISO 8601 start of the milestone period. Needed to decide "commits/releases/packages during the period" criteria; without it those are left to the judge.

amountTotal.description: Tranche value in token base units.

lockup.description: SablierLockup address; required to disambiguate when several versions hold the stream id.

name: milestone-verifier
